outcome: Serum lipid levels (TC, TG, HDL-C, LDL-C, ApoB, ApoA-1, Lp(a), sdLDL)
finding: Non-fasting lipid profiles can be used to estimate lipid metabolism in pregnant women, with significant differences observed in several lipid parameters between pregnant women and controls, both in fasting and non-fasting states.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was associated with TC, HDL-C, LDL-C, ApoA-1, and sdLDL levels in the non-fasting state (2 hours after breakfast).
